Portugal Changes How No. 7 Is Written to Honor Cristiano Ronaldo
news.og_title: Portugal Changes How No. 7 Is Written to Honor Cristiano Ronaldo
news.og_desc: The Portugal football team is making a change to how the No. 7 is written to honor the recently-retired Cristiano Ronaldo. Ronaldo, who wore the number and went on to make it his own as “CR7,” retired from international soccer last week, ending a remarkable career that spanned six World Cups, a European title, and the men’s all-time international scoring record. “Time to debut a new 7. Because there’s one that will be eternal,” the Portuguese national team wrote on social media on Saturday. The post included a goat emoji to signify “Greatest Of All Time.”
